title: graph layer: load issue set once per invocation
description:
Operations currently reloads all issues multiple times per command (list, next, summary, show all re-read files). The repository graph layer should read all files once per invocation and serve every query (counts, incoming relationships, id resolution, dependency checks) from that in-memory graph.
